title: Granny: Armed Escape
tagline: Escape Granny's house with real Counter-Strike 2 guns and sounds.
description: Same house, same Granny, but now you can fight back. Find a knife, pistols, a shotgun and an AK-47 hidden around the house, all using the weapons and sounds from your own Counter-Strike 2. Every shot is loud and Granny hears it, so decide when it's worth it. Put her down and she stays down. Single player. You need both Granny and Counter-Strike 2 installed.
